Container.Name: SD2NAS
Container.Overview:
Imports SD cards into a staging folder as soon as they are inserted, skips anything already imported or archived, and serves a phone-friendly web UI for merging, renaming, culling and promoting staging folders into the archive.
Set up the card script and notifications as the README describes: https://github.com/aspiziri/SD2NAS#readme. After starting, open /healthz to check the time zone, user and mounts.
Container.Requires: Unassigned Devices and Unassigned Devices Plus (they mount the cards), and User Scripts (hourly notices). See https://github.com/aspiziri/SD2NAS#readme

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the web UI. The card script reaches SD2NAS on it: set SD2NAS_URL=http://localhost:<this port> in sd2nas.cfg (see the README).

Config.Name: Cards
Config.Description: Where Unassigned Devices mounts cards. Must be RW/Slave so cards inserted after the container starts are visible. SD2NAS never writes to cards.

Config.Name: Photos share
Config.Description: The photos share. Contains Archive/; SD2NAS creates Staging/ and Management/SD2NAS/ next to it.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database and thumbnail cache. appdata must be an exclusive share (or use the pool path, e.g. /mnt/poolname/appdata/sd2nas) so SQLite bypasses the FUSE share layer.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns created files (99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns created files (100 = users)

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: 000 keeps imported files editable over SMB

Config.Name: Card poller
Config.Description: Only for setups without the Unassigned Devices script: true imports cards that get mounted under /cards after the container starts (it can't unmount them or send Unraid notifications). Leave false when the script is installed.

Config.Name: Password (SD2NAS_TOKEN)
Config.Description: Optional password for the web UI and the card script. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 24 (letters, digits and . _ ~ + / = - only, or SD2NAS won't start). When set, the web UI asks for it once per browser, and the card script must send it: add it single-quoted to sd2nas.cfg as the README shows. Leave empty for no token: then anyone on your network can use SD2NAS.
